nodes.description: Public mapping (address => Holder) storing each holder's unlockTime and balance in pig_BANK.
External Log contract instance stored in pig_BANK and used for event logging.
Public uint minimum balance threshold (1 ether) required before Collect succeeds.
Public payable Put(uint _unlockTime) that credits msg.value to the caller's Holder and sets unlockTime.
Public payable Collect(uint _am) that sends ether to msg.sender via low-level call before decreasing the recorded balance.
Public payable fallback function that forwards execution to Put(0).
Constructor pig_BANK(address log) that wires the Log contract reference.
Public Message[] history array in Log that accumulates all appended messages.
Temporary Message storage struct in Log holding the most recent message before pushing.
Public AddMessage(address,uint,string) in Log that fills LastMsg with block.timestamp and pushes it to History.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key and as the ether transfer recipient.
Block timestamp (now) used for unlock-time comparison and log timestamps.
Low-level msg.sender.call.value(_am)() sending ether to an untrusted address before state update (reentrancy).
acc.balance += msg.value unchecked uint addition that can overflow the stored balance.
acc.balance -= _am unchecked uint subtraction executed after the external call.
acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>now?_unlockTime:now timestamp-dependent assignment (timestamp dependency).
LastMsg.Time = now timestamp-dependent write inside Log.AddMessage (timestamp dependency).
Caller-supplied unlock time parameter of Put.
Caller-supplied withdrawal amount parameter of Collect.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.
Constructor parameter address log used to instantiate the Log contract reference.
Sender address parameter of Log.AddMessage.
Value parameter of Log.AddMessage.
Data string parameter of Log.AddMessage.

edges.reason: Put reads the caller-supplied _unlockTime parameter to compute the unlock time.
Put loads Acc[msg.sender] into the local storage variable acc_put.
Put uses msg.sender as the key for Acc and as the log message sender.
msg.sender indexes the Acc mapping to select the caller's Holder.
Put executes the unchecked balance addition acc.balance += msg.value.
The overflow-prone balance addition writes the resulting balance back into Acc.
_unlockTime flows into the timestamp-dependent unlockTime assignment.
block.timestamp (now) determines the fallback value of unlockTime.
Put performs the timestamp-dependent unlock time update.
Put invokes LogFile.AddMessage for logging through the stored Log instance.
Put makes an external call into the Log contract's AddMessage function.
The fallback function delegates execution to Put(0).
Collect reads the caller-supplied withdrawal amount _am.
Collect loads Acc[msg.sender] into the local storage variable acc_collect.
Collect uses msg.sender both for the balance lookup and as the ether recipient.
Collect reads the MinSum threshold as a withdrawal precondition.
Collect reads and later updates the caller's Holder in the Acc mapping.
Collect performs the low-level value call to msg.sender before updating state.
msg.sender is the untrusted target of the external value transfer.
The balance subtraction happens only after the external call returns, enabling reentrant withdrawal.
Collect compares block.timestamp (now) against acc.unlockTime to gate withdrawal.
Collect calls LogFile.AddMessage after a successful withdrawal.
Collect makes an external call into Log.AddMessage.
The constructor consumes the log address parameter.
The constructor assigns the constructed Log instance to the LogFile state variable.
AddMessage stores the _adr parameter into LastMsg.Sender.
AddMessage stores the _val parameter into LastMsg.Val.
AddMessage stores the _data parameter into LastMsg.Data.
block.timestamp (now) is written into LastMsg.Time, making the log timestamp-dependent.
AddMessage performs the timestamp-dependent LastMsg.Time assignment.
AddMessage writes into the LastMsg storage struct.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is only a parameter of Put and should be folded into the Put function node.
_am is only a parameter of Collect and should be folded into the Collect function node.
acc_put is a function-local storage reference inside Put and should be merged into Put.
acc_collect is a function-local storage reference inside Collect and should be merged into Collect.
log_param is only used by the constructor to initialize LogFile and should be merged into it.
_adr is only a parameter of Log.AddMessage and should be merged into that function.
_val is only a parameter of Log.AddMessage and should be merged into that function.
_data is only a parameter of Log.AddMessage and should be merged into that function.
